ports.note: Fixed local ports manual_test.sh registers the lab devices from (not the shared pool), so a binding the core still holds can only ever reach the same device. Each set is the first of 'slots' ports (media: steps of 10); a run takes the first free slot, since a stopped TCP registration leaves its port in TIME_WAIT for ~60s. 'shared' is the single registration process of the blind/park/hold/upset flows. Open these on the box's firewall/NAT like the pool ports.
